summary: @ornikar/apollo-link-timeout preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases for the host platform, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js` shipped at the package root. `math_init.js` carries a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header and is heavily obfuscated (string-array rotation via `WV8StW`, thousands of encoded numeric/short-token literals) and is executed only under the freshly downloaded Bun binary, bypassing Node-based static analysis. The package presents itself as a scoped fork of the small `apollo-link-timeout` GraphQL utility (drcallaway/apollo-link-timeout), which ships no such runtime download, no alternate-runtime invocation, and no `math_init.js` payload. The name `math_init` and the payload size are inconsistent with an Apollo timeout link. The alternate-runtime dropper executes attacker-controlled bundled code on every installer host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
